لوكالايزر

Questions and answers

What is لوكالايزر?

In this glossary, لوكالايزر refers to: The horizontal guidance component of the ILS, providing lateral alignment with the runway centerline during instrument approaches.

Definition

The horizontal guidance component of the ILS, providing lateral alignment with the runway centerline during instrument approaches.

Operational example

Cleared for the ILS approach Runway 12, report established on the localizer and glide slope.
